cases.title: Repair an atomic reservation race
cases.prompt: Diagnose and repair a concurrent reservation race in a small SQLite-backed service. Preserve failed-call accounting, add multiprocess regression coverage, and produce a concise operator note.

artifacts.name: reservation.py
artifacts.content:
import sqlite3


def reserve(db_path: str, bucket: str, limit: int) -> bool:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path, timeout=5)
    try:
        row = conn.execute("SELECT used FROM reservations WHERE bucket = ?", (bucket,)).fetchone()
        used = int(row[0]) if row else 0
        if used >= limit:
            return False
        conn.execute("INSERT INTO reservations(bucket, used) VALUES(?, 1) ON CONFLICT(bucket) DO UPDATE SET used = ?", (bucket, used + 1))
        conn.commit()
        return True
    finally:
        conn.close()


def record_failed_call(db_path: str, bucket: str) -> None:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    conn.execute("INSERT INTO failed_calls(bucket) VALUES(?)", (bucket,))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()

artifacts.content:
CREATE TABLE reservations(bucket TEXT PRIMARY KEY, used INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE failed_calls(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, bucket TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);
